name: question
description: An interactive user consultation tool that pauses execution to present structured questions with optional choices and awaits user input. Use whenever critical requirements are missing, ambiguities arise, or an action is destructive and irreversible (such as deleting files or altering databases). Use this to prevent unrecoverable mistakes and align with user intent without guessing.

options.description: Up to 4 choices. Omit for an open-ended answer.
